fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-12-07, two persons allegedly entered Mullai Footwear near Amudham Garden Market Road and took cash of about Rs. 50,000 after threatening the staff. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-12-06 at roughly 17:05. The complainant is associated with the business Mullai Footwear. The complainant alleged that Karthik Balan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000380. Padmini Raj (9000000032) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant noted the registration number TN-45-XX-1036 of a green scooter. The complaint refers to another person whose identity could not be established. The complainant mentioned a witness statement. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00280, as the mobile number 9000000380 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects allegedly entered near closing time and threatened the staff. A scooter was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: shop robbery, cash, witness statement, evening, witness, suspect, mobile number, market road
